1.1.0.en: Ability to set sender name in app settings. Bugfix for sending images. After settings change, you no longer need to reload the app.

1.2.0.en: Updated for current Homey firmware (Node.js 22) and the latest nodemailer. New card to send HTML mails. The image card can now include text and shows the image in the mail. Fixed: changed settings were not always used after saving. Clearer error messages when settings are missing.
